assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished fitness mobile app interaction design board, first of two boards.
Use the provided image ONLY as a visual style reference. Design NEW Train-tab screens in exactly the same PORTAL FITNESS app: dark charcoal green black surfaces, restrained lime primary buttons, white readable type, subtle smoky natural texture, modern urban American comic lightly realistic original athletic companion Maya, brown ponytail, black technical sports jacket, friendly confident mature face, no real photo, no chibi, no bizarre anatomy, no neon overload. Young adult men and women audience.
Create a crisp landscape high-resolution 3:2 board with THREE equally large phone screens, fully visible and readable, simple fine connecting arrows below. Title in Chinese exactly "训练页优化 · 两种入口，一个训练流程". Top-right PORTAL FITNESS, subtitle "交互示意 · 示例数据". Match reference polished card shadows, rounded dark panels, generous control spacing. Main product UI in English. Bottom navigation Home / Train / Planet / Body / Me with Train lime-highlighted on first two phones only.
SCREEN 1 caption "01 无计划 · 自由训练": heading "Train", subtitle "Your pace. Your session." Small companion banner Maya upper right and short line "Let's move together." Main prominent empty-plan card "No plan for today", supporting "Start a free workout and add exercises as you go.", wide lime button "Start free workout". Below a quiet secondary card "Prefer a plan?" and outline link "Build today's plan". Show no pre-existing exercise list or fake progress. This CTA explicitly starts free session, later add movements, not forced wizard.
SCREEN 2 caption "02 已有计划 · 查看训练": heading "Train", same subdued small companion. Main "Today's workout" card "Strength training", "20 min · 5 exercises", status "Planned"; rows "Warm-up 3 min", "Strength 14 min", "Cool-down 3 min". Wide lime button "View workout" with chevron, secondary smaller text "Start free workout" allowing free mode. Tiny calm "Changes apply to today." This screen is browsing, no running timer.
SCREEN 3 caption "03 训练计划内容": back chevron, "Workout plan", "Strength training", "20 min · 5 exercises", quiet edit icon. The list clearly grouped "Warm-up · 3 min" with "Arm circles" and "3 min"; "Strength · 14 min" with THREE compact rows "Squat — 3 sets × 10 reps", "Push-up — 3 sets × 8 reps", "Plank — 3 sets × 30 sec"; "Cool-down · 3 min" with "Standing stretch — 3 min". Small stylized exercise thumbnail per row, NOT photo. Content visible with compact clean rows. Bottom fixed primary "Start planned workout". No timing begins simply by visiting this page. Footnote inside screen "Preview your exercises before starting." No bottom nav on detail screen; keep safe area.
Footer diagram captions compact Chinese "无计划：直接开练 → 添加动作" and "有计划：首页/训练入口 → 查看内容 → 开始训练". These examples are a UI concept, not medical prescriptions. No extra rewards, heart rate, calories, premium, socials, no planetary full scene taking up train content. Keep legible consistent typography, accurate specified labels, no crop.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: second detailed interaction board of the PORTAL FITNESS mobile Train flow.
Input images: image1 latest homepage visual style; image2 new Train entry and preview board, same app, reuse its typography/card system and exercise thumbnail aesthetic. Create NEW screens continuing that flow. Dark charcoal black green, restrained pale lime primary controls, white type, rounded dark translucent cards, modern sporty subtly technological, original lightly realistic American urban comic illustrations, no real photography, no chibi, no bizarre effects. Large content-focused interface, companion Maya only small avatar plus one short encouraging line.
Landscape high-resolution 3:2 board, THREE large equally sized phones. Chinese title exactly "训练进行中 · 添加动作与按计划执行". Top-right PORTAL FITNESS with "交互示意 · 示例数据". Captions below phones "04 自由训练 · 添加动作", "05 选择动作 · 确认加入", "06 计划训练 · 逐组执行".
SCREEN1: full running session titled "Free workout", back arrow. Compact top status "In progress" with elapsed "02:18" and tiny "Elapsed time". Maya tiny avatar and "Make it your own." No existing exercises, central calm dashed empty panel with simple dumbbell icon, "Add your first exercise", secondary "Choose an exercise to keep going.", large lime "Add exercise" button. Small status "No exercises added yet". Bottom fixed two controls "Pause" outline and "Finish workout" understated. This session is already started, don't show Start button. No bottom tabbar on running session.
SCREEN2: action-picker bottom sheet fills 85% above dimmed Free workout background, top grabber, title "Add exercises", close x, search "Search exercises", chips "All" selected lime, "Upper body", "Lower body", "Core". Four dark rows with small nonphoto comic movement thumbnails: "Squat" subtitle "Lower body · Reps" checked lime; "Push-up" subtitle "Upper body · Reps" checked lime; "Plank" subtitle "Core · Timed" unselected; "Arm circles" subtitle "Warm-up · Timed" unselected. Selected rows have thin lime outline and clear checks. Bottom helper "2 selected", fixed wide lime "Add selected (2)". No save plan button, no workout timer reset. Results list is scrollable, roomy clear.
SCREEN3: running planned session "Strength training" with back. Status row "In progress", actual elapsed demo "04:32". Stage tracker "Warm-up" checked, "Strength" highlighted, "Cool-down" upcoming. Current exercise card "Squat", "Set 1 of 3", large lightly realistic comic woman doing athletic squat in technical sportswear, avoid revealing clothing. Target readable "10 reps" with text "Target". Bottom of card one small line "Mark each set when you're done." Progress line "1 of 5 exercises completed". Below "Up next" compact "Push-up · 3 sets × 8 reps". Main lime "Complete set", below outline "Pause" and plain "Finish workout". User manually confirms set; no fake AI sensor, no calories/heart rate/XP. No tabbar. No automatic medical claims. These are UI samples not workout advice.
Below phones thin lines and concise Chinese path "自由训练：开练 → 选择动作 → 确认添加" and "计划训练：查看内容 → 开始 → 完成每组". Include small footer "动作与数据为交互示例". Keep all visible, clear exact English words, consistent no overloaded artwork, no crop.
